title: Hiring velocity role-sync + 15-day condensed onboarding checklist
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a compact, operational playbook for hiring managers and People Ops to run a fast but high-quality 'role-sync -> interview -> decision -> 15-day onboarding' flow for mid-SWE and IC hiring. The goal: reduce time-to-offer without sacrificing signal quality or new-hire ramp clarity.

Scope & when to use:
- Use for IC roles where we expect a <6-week pipeline + 2-week accelerated onboarding (e.g., urgent capacity hires, product-led squads).
- Not for director/executive hires or highly regulated private deployment positions (use full hiring kit).

High-level cadence (recommended):
1) Role-sync meeting (30–45m) — within 48 hours of req approval
2) Interview panel formation & rubric prep (24–48h)
3) Screen + loop scheduling (2 weeks target)
4) Debrief + decision within 48h of last interview
5) Offer + 3-day acceptance handshake
6) 15-day condensed onboarding runbook starts on day 0

Role-sync template (30–45m):
- Attendees: hiring manager, 1 eng lead, People Ops recruiter, 1 cross-functional stakeholder (PM/QA).
- Agenda bullets (bring to meeting):
  - Outcome expectation (first 90d impact) — 2–3 measurable outcomes
  - Must-have vs nice-to-have skills (explicit split)
  - Interview probes to verify each must-have (one-liners)
  - Team culture fit anchors (1–2 behaviors we need more of)
  - Ramp plan sketch (what the hire will own on day 30 and day 90)
  - Red flags (non-negotiables for decline)

Interview rubric (compact):
- Areas (4): System design / architecture, Coding & problem solving, Product judgment & tradeoffs, Collaboration & ownership
- Score bands: 1 (insufficient), 2 (below), 3 (meets), 4 (exceeds), 5 (standout) — translate to pass/fail: >=3 is pass for loop, >=4 strong hire
- Quick guidance: every interviewer should map evidence to outcomes from role-sync (explicit bullet)

Suggested phone screen (25m):
- 6 min intro + role expectations (hiring manager or recruiter notes)
- 12 min coding/system-thinking (one focused prompt)
- 7 min behavioral + logistics (remote status, start date, comp expectations)

Loop structure (onsite/virtual, 3x45m panels):
- Panel A: Coding + test-first design (owner: eng lead)
- Panel B: System design for first-quarter scope (owner: staff engineer)
- Panel C: Collaboration + async comms + alignment with product (owner: PM or lead)
- Debrief: 20–30m immediately after last panel; record key signals (strengths, risks, red flags).

Decision rubric & hiring committee quick-check: 
- Pass if: majority of interviewers >=3 AND at least one >=4 in primary area
- Recruiter check: comp band, notice period, references flagged (quick check)
- Hiring manager closes decision and writes 2-sentence hire rationale for offer docs

Offer timeline targets:
- Offer prepared within 24h of decision; verbal within 48h; written within 72h

15-day condensed onboarding checklist (owner assigned in role-sync):
- Day 0 (pre-start): IT access requested, desk/hardware procured, calendar invites for orientation sent, first-week objectives drafted
- Day 1: 2-hour welcome + team orientation; 1:1 with hiring manager to go over 30/60/90 outcomes; environment and repo walkthrough; small repo task assigned (non-critical bug)
- Day 3: Pair session on codebase; first small PR expected; review of monitoring and deploy process; cost/infra policies overview
- Day 5: Deliverable review (PR merged or feedback loop closed); product/PM sync on first-quarter work; scheduling of recurring 1:1s and onboarding check-ins
- Day 8: Cross-functional stakeholder intros (SRE/QA/PM); runbook for oncall (if applicable) shared; security checklist 50% complete
- Day 12: First infra walkthrough (deploy pipeline, staging smoke tests); performance objective alignment with manager; identify mentor for next 90d
- Day 15: 30-day plan finalized, acceptance of first small deliverable, onboarding retrospective (30m) with manager + People Ops (what went well, blockers)

Owner responsibilities (quick):
- Hiring manager: role-sync prep, interview feedback synthesis, 30/60/90 outcomes, offer rationale
- Recruiter: schedule, comp band, offer paperwork, candidate comms tempo
- People Ops: onboarding checklist owner, access audit, orientation content, 15-day retrospective facilitator

Scorecard template (one-line each field to paste into candidate doc):
- Candidate name:
- Role:
- Interview date:
- Scores: coding X, system design Y, product Z, collaboration W
- Pass/Fail:
- Primary hire risk(s):
- Manager hire rationale (2 lines):

Handoff checklist for accepted offers (pre-boarding):
- Confirm start date and time zone
- Confirm payroll/contract paperwork returned
- Order hardware + confirm shipping ETA
- Slack + email account creation + team channel invites
- Access to required repos + vault secrets (ticket to infra)

Fast failure & fallback guidance:
- If any red flag surfaces during loop, pause and call a quick sync with hiring manager + recruiter within 24h to decide next steps (reject vs targeted addl interview)
- If candidate withdraws after verbal, run rapid re-open: 48h to re-engage top of slate or convert internal backfill

Open questions / follow-ups: 
- Can we centralize a 15-day onboarding checklist generator in HRIS? (confluence ticket linked above)
- Need a small PR template for day-1/3 tasks to standardize signal across teams

Notes to self / quick links:
- Slack thread: #people-hiring-velocity (pin this doc)
- Reuse this doc as a repo entry point for hiring managers to copy/paste the role-sync bullets
- Next iteration: add one-paragraph 'first-90d impact profile' template to speed role-sync
